edition: Metal Gear: Ghost Babel (Game Boy Color)
coordinates: All coordinates are in native image pixels. sourceRectXYWH is the exported bounds in the atlas. Place pivotXY at the joint. The Y axis points down. No texture was scaled, mirrored or rotated. In pass30 the PNGs are trimmed to their nonzero alpha bounds. Rig offsets, z and scale retain their engine values.
rasterization: Native clips use the even-odd rule at pixel centers. The RGBA tuple outside the clip becomes transparent black. The source PNG and rig remain authoritative.
